heading_en: Amount of Credit Risk-Weighted Assets for Corporate, etc. Exposures
summary_ja: 事業法人等向けエクスポージャーの信用リスク・アセットの額の算式(K、R、b)、中堅中小企業・大規模規制金融機関等の相関係数、スロッティング・クライテリア及びクレジット・デリバティブの取扱いを定める。
summary_en: Gives the risk-weight formula for corporate, etc. exposures (K, correlation R, maturity adjustment b), with variants for SMEs, large financial institutions, high-volatility commercial real estate and slotting criteria, and rules for credit derivatives.
paragraphs: The amount of credit risk-weighted assets for corporate, etc. exposures shall be the amount calculated, using the PD provided in Article 132, the LGD provided in Article 133, the EAD provided in Article 134 and the maturity (M) provided in Article 135 (1 where PD is 100%; the same applies hereinafter), by the formula in item (i); the required capital ratio (K) necessary for calculating the formula in item (i) shall be calculated by the formula in item (ii); and the correlation coefficient (R) and the maturity adjustment (b) necessary for calculating the formula in item (ii) shall be calculated by the formulas in item (iii) and item (iv), respectively. (i) Credit risk-weighted assets = K × 12.5 × EAD. (ii) {{F:p160i0}} Where this is below zero, it shall be zero. N{x} is the cumulative distribution function of the standard normal distribution. However, where PD is 100%, it shall be 1 (the same applies hereinafter). G(x) is the inverse function of N{x} (the same applies hereinafter). EL is the rate obtained by multiplying PD by LGD; provided, however, that where PD is 100%, it shall be EL_{default} provided in Article 194, paragraph (6) (the same applies hereinafter). (iii) {{F:p161i0}} EXP(x) is the value of the base of the natural logarithm raised to the power x (the same applies hereinafter). (iv) Maturity adjustment (b) = {0.11852 − 0.05478 × log(PD)}^{2}. log(x) denotes the natural logarithm (the same applies hereinafter).

Notwithstanding the preceding paragraph, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach may, in calculating the amount of credit risk-weighted assets for SME exposures, use the following correlation coefficient in place of the correlation coefficient provided in paragraph (1), item (iii). {{F:p161i1}} S is the sales of the corporate (total assets in the case provided in the proviso to Article 1, item (li)) (in units of 100 million yen); provided, however, that where it is less than 500 million yen, it shall be calculated as 500 million yen.

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach calculates the amount of credit risk-weighted assets for exposures to large regulated financial institutions, etc. (including those that fall under SME exposures), it shall, notwithstanding the preceding two paragraphs, use as the correlation coefficient the value obtained by multiplying the correlation coefficient provided in paragraph (1), item (iii) or in the preceding paragraph by 1.25, in place of the correlation coefficient provided in those provisions.

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach does not satisfy the requirements provided in Article 191 for estimating PD for specialized lending excluding high-volatility commercial real estate lending, it may, notwithstanding paragraph (1), assign the rating it grants (hereinafter referred to as the "internal rating") to the slotting criteria corresponding to the risk weights set out in the following table, and treat as the amount of credit risk-weighted assets the amount obtained by multiplying the exposure amount (meaning EAD) by that risk weight; provided, however, that, excluding those classified as commercial real estate lending as provided in the proviso to Article 1, item (xlix), (b), where the remaining term to maturity of an exposure assigned to Strong or Good in the following table is less than two and a half years, a risk weight of 50% may be applied to an exposure assigned to Strong, and a risk weight of 70% to an exposure assigned to Good. {{T:p162t0}}

Notwithstanding paragraph (1), the amount of credit risk-weighted assets for high-volatility commercial real estate lending shall be the amount calculated using the following correlation coefficient in place of the correlation coefficient provided in item (iii) of that paragraph. {{F:p162i0}}

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach does not satisfy the requirements provided in Article 191 for estimating PD for high-volatility commercial real estate lending, it may, notwithstanding paragraph (1), assign the internal rating to the slotting criteria corresponding to the risk weights set out in the following table, and treat as the amount of credit risk-weighted assets the amount obtained by multiplying the exposure amount (meaning EAD) by that risk weight; provided, however, that where the remaining term to maturity of an exposure assigned to Strong or Good in the following table is less than two and a half years, a risk weight of 70% may be applied to an exposure assigned to Strong, and a risk weight of 95% to an exposure assigned to Good. {{T:p162t1}}

The provisions of Article 112 shall apply mutatis mutandis where the amount of credit risk-weighted assets is calculated under the preceding paragraphs. In this case, the term "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" in that Article shall be read as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach", and the phrase "summing the risk weights up to a maximum of 1,250%, and multiplying the credit equivalent amount of that credit derivative by that risk weight, to calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets" shall be read as "summing the required capital ratios up to a maximum of 100%, and multiplying the result by the EAD of that credit derivative and by 1,250%, to calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets; provided, however, that where the sum of the amount of credit risk-weighted assets and the amount obtained by dividing the expected loss amount by 8% exceeds the amount obtained by multiplying the EAD of that credit derivative by 1,250%, the excess amount may be deducted from the amount of credit risk-weighted assets".

The provisions of Article 114 shall apply mutatis mutandis where the amount of credit risk-weighted assets is calculated under paragraphs (1) through (6). In this case, the term "Article 112" in that Article shall be read as "Article 112 as applied mutatis mutandis with replacement of terms under Article 129, paragraph (7)", "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach", "'shall calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets'" as "'may deduct'", and "shall calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets; provided, however, that the amount of credit risk-weighted assets reduced for the single exposure, among the multiple exposures that may be covered by the protection, whose credit risk-weighted assets are reduced least when the risk weight of the protection provider is applied up to the notional principal amount of that credit derivative may be deducted" as "shall deduct, and may deduct the amount of credit risk-weighted assets reduced for the single exposure, among the multiple exposures that may be covered by the protection, whose credit risk-weighted assets are reduced least when the required capital ratio of the protection provider is applied up to the EAD of that credit derivative".

The provisions of Article 115 shall apply mutatis mutandis where the amount of credit risk-weighted assets is calculated under paragraphs (1) through (6). In this case, the term "Article 112" in that Article shall be read as "Article 112 as applied mutatis mutandis with replacement of terms under Article 129, paragraph (7)", "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach", "'shall calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets'" as "'may deduct'", and "shall calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets; provided, however, that the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets reduced for the exposures, among the multiple exposures that may be covered by the protection, counting from the single exposure whose credit risk-weighted assets are reduced least up to the rank obtained by subtracting one from the rank specified in advance in that nth-to-default credit derivative, when the risk weight of the protection provider is applied up to the notional principal amount of that credit derivative, may be deducted" as "shall deduct, and may deduct the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets reduced for the exposures, among the multiple exposures that may be covered by the protection, counting from the single exposure whose credit risk-weighted assets are reduced least up to the rank obtained by subtracting one from the rank specified in advance in that nth-to-default credit derivative, when the required capital ratio of the protection provider is applied up to the EAD of that credit derivative".

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach applies the formula for the required capital ratio (K) provided in paragraph (1), item (ii) to exposures included in a netting set for which the CVA risk equivalent amount is measured using BA-CVA or SA-CVA, it may cap at 1 the part {1 − 1.5 × b}^{−1} × {1 + (M − 2.5) × b} of that formula.
